description: Check the program's custom domain DNS now and return the result in `isVerified`. Call it after the `CNAME` record from `dnsRecord` is in place. If the record is wrong or has not propagated yet, `isVerified` stays `false`; try again later. The first time the check passes, GrowSurf sets up the domain's SSL certificate, and pages can take a few minutes to load over `https://` after that. More than one `CNAME` record on the hostname returns `400`. Returns `404` when no custom domain is set. A domain that is already verified is returned as is, without a new check. Targets `campaignId` if supplied, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_verify_campaign_custom_domain

outputSchema.description: The custom domain after the live DNS check. Same shape as the `growsurf_get_campaign_custom_domain` result.

title: Verify Program Custom Domain
